description: Roll sealed dice freight through fixed action-settled apertures while maintaining its labelled 3D orientation.
name: Blind Dice Courier V2 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Roll the die through the single fixed opening to the dock. Any face is accepted. One press settles one square in 0.4 seconds. Keep the whole tipping die inside the opening until it clears. Shutter contact or an incomplete submission ends the episode. Waiting between rolls does not change the aperture.
